copy.title: Suresec Locksmiths | Official Brand Site & Branch Directory
copy.description: Suresec Locksmiths — security done to standard. Eight branches from the Thames Valley to Tyneside fitting BS3621 and TS007-rated hardware, with free door-by-door security checks and insurance-compliant certification.
copy.topbar: BS3621 · TS007 3-star · PAS 24 — if your insurer names a standard, we fit to it
copy.h1: Would your locks pass your insurer's small print?
copy.lead: Most people find out what BS3621 means the day a claim is questioned. Suresec's eight branches — from Abingdon and Aldershot up to Gateshead — check doors and windows against the standards your policy actually names, then fit certified hardware and put it in writing.
copy.heroNote: {n} branches from the Thames Valley to Tyneside. Every visit ends with your locks documented, not guessed at.

coverage.heading: The Suresec branch directory
coverage.intro: Eight branches, each with its own surveyor-minded locksmiths and its own local number. The areas listed are streets they walk regularly — pick your town for the full branch site.
coverage.areaPattern: Surveys and upgrades across {areas} and the wider {town} area

services.heading: From survey to certificate
services.intro: The Suresec visit has a shape: check everything, fix what fails, document what's fitted. These are the pieces.
featured: Certified BS3621 mortice locks and TS007 3-star cylinders, fitted and recorded against your policy wording.
Non-compliant or worn hardware swapped for rated equivalents — with the old spec noted so you can see the difference.
Key-operated window locks brought up to the standard most contents policies quietly require.
A failing mechanism is a failing standard. Repaired to spec or honestly condemned.
Post-incident reinstatement your insurer will accept, with photographs and hardware certificates for the claim.
Rated safes, correctly anchored, matched to your insurer's cash and valuables limits.
24/7 response — and the emergency fix is done with certified hardware, not a temporary bodge.

why.heading: Why standards are the whole point
points: Every branch offers a no-obligation door-by-door check against BS3621, TS007 and PAS 24 — you get the findings whether or not you book work.
Job sheets record exactly what was fitted and to what standard. If an insurer ever asks, the answer is in writing.
No unbranded cylinders, no mystery mortices. If it goes on your door, it carries a kitemark or a star rating.
The same checklist in Skegness as in Welwyn Garden City — eight branches marking against the same sheet.

cta.heading: Book the free security check
cta.sub: Your local Suresec branch will tell you exactly where your home stands — no obligation, no jargon.

copy.footerBlurb: The official site of Suresec Locksmiths — eight branches fitting and certifying insurance-standard security from the Thames Valley to Tyneside.
